description: Election Commission  -  Vacated his office member of Galle Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns the vacation of office by a member of the Galle Municipal Council due to ceasing membership in a political party. It is a formal declaration made under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance regarding an elected official's status. The content is directly related to electoral processes and the composition of an elected local authority, fitting the definition of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
